visualCharacteristics.purpose: Golden-ticket editorial band: star-bracketed title, body copy and CTAs beside an image.

contentPattern.structure: A text cell (heading = title, CTA paragraphs = links, other paragraphs = body) and a picture-only cell (media). In qr, a centred column with title, QR card and note.

usage: Editorial text-and-image band in a campaign page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse promo-editorial wherever the same content pattern appears; authored content is moved into the block's layout, so keep the structure above.
